subject: Subcommittee Policy and Structure Revisions
overview: The committee met to revise policies governing how subcommittees are convened and the process for referring business to them. The body approved a new structure requiring full committee referral for most business while allowing for annual listening sessions and adjusting the list of standing subcommittees.

items.title: Subcommittee Meeting Policy
items.summary: Approved a policy requiring subcommittees to conduct only business referred by a majority vote of the full committee, with an amendment allowing each subcommittee to hold one annual listening session for community input.

items.title: Standing Subcommittee Assignments
items.summary: Voted to remove 'Pupil Services' from the proposed list of standing subcommittees to prevent duplication of responsibilities with the Special Education and Behavioral Health subcommittee.
